theorems.statement: ∀ (m k P : ℕ) (ι : Euclid m →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid P) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid P) (b : Euclid k) (R : ℝ) (β : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) m) (gs : ℕ → Euclid m → Euclid k) (As : ℕ → Set (Euclid m)) (A : Set (Euclid m)), Continuous β → HasCompactSupport β → (∀ i, MeasurableSet (As i)) → MeasurableSet A → Tendsto (fun i => volume (symmDiff (As i) A ∩ ball (0 : Euclid m) R)) atTop (𝓝 0) → (∀ᶠ i in atTop, ∀ w ∈ ball (0 : Euclid m) R, DifferentiableAt ℝ (gs i) w) → (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ i in atTop, ∀ w ∈ ball (0 : Euclid m) R, ‖gs i w - b‖ < ε ∧ ‖fderiv ℝ (gs i) w‖ < ε) → Tendsto (fun i => ∫ w in As i ∩ ball 0 R, β (ι w + ι' (gs i w)) (fun j => fderiv ℝ (fun w => ι w + ι' (gs i w)) w (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)))) atTop (𝓝 (∫ w in A ∩ ball 0 R, β (ι w + ι' b) (fun j => ι (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)))))
